cases.name: a-formula-in-a-mix-case
cases.description: The case that was reported: a formula in one branch of a <mix>. Each row the branch holds is computed from that row — Y * 2 + X — and the mix split stays exact. It used to pass check and stop the run with `gen type "formula" not yet supported`.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="12" seed="br" local="en" mode="memory"><sequence name="X"><gen type="number" value="0..3"/></sequence><sequence name="Y"><gen type="number" value="10..20"/></sequence><mix name="C" percent="40,60"><case><data>-</data></case><case><gen type="formula" expr="Y * 2 + X"/></case></mix></env><block><line><data>${{X}} ${{Y}} ${{C}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: a-formula-in-a-switch-default-computes-only-its-rows
cases.description: A <default> is built over the whole run and picked from. Y / X is a refusal on the X = 0 rows — and those rows belong to the other case, so the formula must never be asked about them. The streaming engine only computes what it keeps; the in-memory engine has to do the same, or one config runs on one engine and fails on the other.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="12" seed="br" local="en" mode="memory"><sequence name="X"><gen type="number" value="0..3"/></sequence><sequence name="Y"><gen type="number" value="10..20"/></sequence><switch name="C" on="X"><case is="0"><data>none</data></case><default><gen type="formula" expr="Y / X" decimals="2"/></default></switch></env><block><line><data>${{X}} ${{Y}} ${{C}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: a-formula-in-a-multi-key-case
cases.description: A multi-key case is the other branch that cannot be numbered row by row, so it is built over the whole run too. The guard is the same: X - 1 is zero on rows this case does not hold.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="12" seed="br" local="en" mode="memory"><sequence name="X"><gen type="number" value="0..3"/></sequence><sequence name="Y"><gen type="number" value="10..20"/></sequence><switch name="C" on="X"><case is="0|1"><data>low</data></case><case is="2|3"><gen type="formula" expr="Y / (X - 1)" decimals="1"/></case></switch></env><block><line><data>${{X}} ${{Y}} ${{C}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: a-formula-in-a-switch-nested-in-a-case
cases.description: Two levels down: a <switch> inside a <mix> case, with the formula in its <default>. Only the rows both levels keep are computed.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="12" seed="br" local="en" mode="memory"><sequence name="X"><gen type="number" value="0..3"/></sequence><mix name="C" percent="30,70"><case><data>none</data></case><case><data>[</data><switch on="X"><case is="0"><data>zero</data></case><default><gen type="formula" expr="12 / X"/></default></switch><data>]</data></case></mix></env><block><line><data>${{X}} ${{C}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: a-formula-as-an-if-branch
cases.description: A plain formula reads only its own row, so it may be one of the if= branches; it used to be refused (TDC295) together with the constructs that really are whole columns. The branch is built only on the rows it wins, so Y / X never sees an X of zero.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="12" seed="br" local="en" mode="memory"><sequence name="X"><gen type="number" value="0..3"/></sequence><sequence name="Y"><gen type="number" value="10..20"/></sequence><sequence name="C"><gen if="X > 0" type="formula" expr="Y / X" decimals="1"/><gen type="text" value="-"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{X}} ${{Y}} ${{C}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: a-formula-in-a-branch-counts-the-row-it-lands-on
cases.description: _count inside a branch is the row the value lands on, as it is everywhere else — not the value’s place among the rows the branch holds.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="8" seed="br" local="en" mode="memory"><sequence name="X"><gen type="number" value="0..3"/></sequence><mix name="C"><case><data>-</data></case><case><gen type="formula" expr="_count * 10"/></case></mix></env><block><line><data>${{_count}} ${{C}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: a-formula-in-a-branch-over-an-empty-cell
cases.description: A column that is empty on this row leaves the formula’s part empty — a zero nobody generated is not an answer.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="8" seed="br" local="en" mode="memory"><sequence name="N"><gen type="number" value="1..9" missing="0.5"/></sequence><mix name="C"><case><data>n=</data><gen type="formula" expr="N + 1"/></case></mix></env><block><line><data>${{N}}|${{C}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: a-date-offset-in-a-mix-case
cases.description: The silent half of the report: a date offset in a <case> dropped of= and plus= and drew an unrelated date — `D=2020-03-05 C=1975-09-23` — from a config check called valid. Every measured row is now its own D plus one day.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="8" seed="br" local="en" mode="memory"><sequence name="D"><gen type="date" from="2026-01-01" to="2026-12-31" format="YYYY-MM-DD"/></sequence><mix name="C" percent="50"><case><data>-</data></case><case><gen type="date" of="D" plus="1d" format="YYYY-MM-DD"/></case></mix></env><block><line><data>${{D}} ${{C}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: a-date-offset-in-a-case-measures-the-value-not-its-spelling
cases.description: The source is written DD.MM.YYYY, which nothing should guess at. It keeps the instant it generated beside its text because an offset inside a <case> reads it — the same promise the whole-column offset makes.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="8" seed="br" local="en" mode="memory"><sequence name="D"><gen type="date" from="2026-01-01" to="2026-12-31" format="DD.MM.YYYY"/></sequence><sequence name="X"><gen type="number" value="0..3"/></sequence><switch name="C" on="X"><case is="0"><data>-</data></case><default><gen type="date" of="D" plus="1mo" format="D MMMM YYYY"/></default></switch></env><block><line><data>${{D}} ${{X}} ${{C}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: a-ranged-date-offset-in-a-case
cases.description: A ranged plus= draws its step from the row’s own stream, so the step a row gets does not depend on which other rows the branch holds. The expected lines pin the exact dates.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="10" seed="br" local="en" mode="memory"><sequence name="D"><gen type="date" from="2026-01-01" to="2026-12-31" format="YYYY-MM-DD"/></sequence><mix name="C" percent="40,60"><case><data>-</data></case><case><gen type="date" of="D" plus="3..10d" format="YYYY-MM-DD"/></case></mix></env><block><line><data>${{D}} ${{C}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: a-date-offset-as-the-fallback-branch
cases.description: After the if= branches, the fallback measures a week back from its own row.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="8" seed="br" local="en" mode="memory"><sequence name="D"><gen type="date" from="2026-01-01" to="2026-12-31" format="YYYY-MM-DD"/></sequence><sequence name="X"><gen type="number" value="0..3"/></sequence><sequence name="C"><gen if="X == 0" type="text" value="-"/><gen type="date" of="D" plus="-1w" format="YYYY-MM-DD"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{D}} ${{X}} ${{C}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: a-date-offset-in-a-branch-over-an-empty-cell
cases.description: A source row with no date measures nothing: the offset’s part is empty, beside the literal that is still printed.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="8" seed="br" local="en" mode="memory"><sequence name="D"><gen type="date" from="2026-01-01" to="2026-12-31" format="YYYY-MM-DD" missing="0.5"/></sequence><mix name="C"><case><data>d=</data><gen type="date" of="D" plus="-2d" format="YYYY-MM-DD"/></case></mix></env><block><line><data>${{D}}|${{C}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: a formula as the fallback branch
cases.description: After the if= branches, the fallback computes from its own row; the branch above takes the rows where it would divide by zero, so it is never asked about them.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="12" seed="br" local="en" mode="memory"><sequence name="X"><gen type="number" value="0..3"/></sequence><sequence name="Y"><gen type="number" value="10..20"/></sequence><sequence name="C"><gen if="X == 0" type="text" value="-"/><gen type="formula" expr="Y / X" decimals="1"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{X}} ${{Y}} ${{C}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: a date offset carrying its own if
cases.description: A date offset may carry if= now: TDC295 used to refuse it together with the constructs that really are whole columns. The branch measures only the rows it wins.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="8" seed="br" local="en" mode="memory"><sequence name="D"><gen type="date" from="2026-01-01" to="2026-12-31" format="YYYY-MM-DD"/></sequence><sequence name="X"><gen type="number" value="0..3"/></sequence><sequence name="C"><gen if="X > 1" type="date" of="D" plus="1w" format="YYYY-MM-DD"/><gen type="text" value="-"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{D}} ${{X}} ${{C}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: a date offset in a switch nested inside a case
cases.description: Two levels down, the offset still measures from its own row's date, and the source keeps its instant because the offset reads it from inside the case.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="10" seed="br" local="en" mode="memory"><sequence name="D"><gen type="date" from="2026-01-01" to="2026-12-31" format="DD.MM.YYYY"/></sequence><sequence name="X"><gen type="number" value="0..3"/></sequence><mix name="C" percent="30,70"><case><data>-</data></case><case><switch on="X"><case is="0"><data>zero</data></case><default><gen type="date" of="D" plus="2d" format="YYYY-MM-DD"/></default></switch></case></mix></env><block><line><data>${{D}} ${{X}} ${{C}}</data></line></block></tdc>
